title: AI fabric Hugging Face to vLLM deployment
description: Phase 0 PSTF gate for the Slice 1 Hugging Face model import and GPU/vLLM deployment flow.
in_scope: Endpoint state and smoke evaluation publication
out_of_scope: HF resolver, vLLM adapter, UI, or gateway implementation
preconditions: Phase 0 protocol contract is under review.
Current executable evidence is limited to local fake/no-network D4 harnesses.
postconditions: Acceptance criteria are mapped to D4 harness tests that classify evidence as non-production.
Production integration verification remains tracked by bahia-jicv.
non_functional_requirements: Nostr-native event-driven semantics; no HTTP polling as completion truth.
